[Council File 26-1228]
ITA and City Attorney reports relative to the employment status of the former LA CityView Channel 35 contractor workers, and the applicability and enforcement of the City’s Worker Retention Ordinance.
Fiscal Impact Statement:

outcome.text: Arts, Parks, and City Facilities Committee action: Approved as Amended: Noted and Filed the Information Technology Agency report dated 9-23-26, and the City Attorney reports dated 10-14-26 and 10-29-26; and, Approved an instruction to the Information Technology Agency by Motion (Rodriguez - Nazarian - Yaroslavsky) (Nov 4, 2026)
